releaseNotes.content:
## Introduction

Configuration script for FrSky XAct.

## V2.0.1

- Introduced more configurable parameters for XAct.

## V2.0.2

- Move to device config category Servos.

## V2.0.3

- Add back the configuration with the S.Port interface.
- Introduce i18n support.

If you are running Ethos 1.6.0 or later, you can find it in the Device Config menu.
